name: How long does it take to install closet built-ins?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install closet built-ins?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation timeline for closet built-ins varies depending on the complexity of the design and the size of your space. Typically, a standard custom closet project, from initial consultation to final installation, can take several weeks. The actual on-site installation usually occurs over a few days once materials are prepared. We provide a detailed project schedule after the design finalization, giving you process clarity on each step and expected completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time for closet built-ins varies by complexity, but most projects are completed within a few weeks from design to final install, with on-site work taking a few days.
